about.title: About
about.lead: 9 years building systems where data has to be right
body: For 9+ years I have built systems for government agencies, universities and private companies — mostly where accuracy and auditability matter: finance, risk management, internal control, project planning and HR.

I start by understanding how people actually work, then design systems that are easy to maintain and connect cleanly to what an organisation already runs, such as ERP, workflow engines and e-signature.
